items.quote: When you create a bot user in the Developer Portal, Discord generates a **bot token**.
items.why: Quote covers only bot token from Developer Portal; not oauth2, api_key, basic.

items.quote: Using an OAuth2 bearer token gained through the [OAuth2 API](https://docs.discord.com/developers/topics/oauth2.md).
items.why: Quote covers OAuth2 bearer tokens only; not the full method list.

items.quote: Some scopes require approval from Discord to use.
items.why: Quote says some scopes need approval; no mention of verification or intents.

items.quote: Bot users are automatically added to all apps, and are authenticated using the bot token found in your [app's settings](https://discord.com/developers/applications).
items.why: Quote is about bot token auth; says nothing on REST/WebSocket or API breadth.

items.quote: A [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/introduction) server for the Discord API using [(JDA)](https://jda.wiki/),
items.why: Quote shows a Discord MCP server exists; no vendor status or URL shown.

items.quote: Verified bots](https://support-dev.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/23926564536471-How-Do-I-Get-My-App-Verified) do not have a maximum number of guilds.
items.why: Quote is about verified bots having no guild cap; verdict not stated.
